options.label: Exact Modify plus automatic Synchronize
options.effect: Require the current-process allow ACE to contain exactly FileSystemRights.Modify plus the automatically added Synchronize bit, with no ChangePermissions, TakeOwnership, FullControl, generic-all, or unknown bits.
options.tradeoff: Matches documented .NET allow-mask behavior while preserving least privilege; a future attempt must still prove the normalized mask in memory.

options.label: Raw Modify equality
options.effect: Continue requiring the returned enum to equal Modify without normalization.
options.tradeoff: Preserves U3G logic and is expected to fail when .NET adds Synchronize to an allow ACE.

options.label: Required rights subset
options.effect: Pass when all Modify bits are present regardless of additional rights.
options.tradeoff: More portable but can silently accept ChangePermissions, TakeOwnership, or other excessive rights.

options.label: Current process FullControl
options.effect: Change the intended current-process rule from Modify to FullControl.
options.tradeoff: Avoids normalization ambiguity by granting unnecessary privilege and weakens the accepted policy.

options.label: Independent normalized tuple checks
options.effect: Verify exactly three explicit allow tuples by in-memory SID, normalized rights, inheritance, propagation, and access type; calculate unauthorized-principal absence independently from rights matching and persist only bounded booleans.
options.tradeoff: Prevents a rights-normalization failure from being mislabeled as a broad principal while retaining strict principal and rule-count controls.

options.label: Raw SDDL equality
options.effect: Build expected SDDL and compare the entire returned descriptor as text.
options.tradeoff: Strict but vulnerable to harmless canonical ACE ordering or representation differences and handles identity data more broadly.

options.label: Effective access only
options.effect: Check whether the current process can perform the probe without validating exact ACE structure.
options.tradeoff: Proves operability but cannot prove absence of inherited, broad, deny, or excessive explicit rules.

options.label: Manual ACL review
options.effect: Persist no automated tuple decision and require a person to inspect the ACL.
options.tradeoff: Weakens repeatability and conflicts with the sanitized automated evidence model.

options.label: Native Windows PowerShell scalar projection
options.effect: In a future separately authorized attempt, invoke a bounded local Windows PowerShell 5.1 child process with NoProfile and NonInteractive, run Get-MpComputerStatus there, validate required property presence and scalar types there, and return only allowlisted JSON scalars.
options.tradeoff: Eliminates PowerShell 7 compatibility-proxy ambiguity but requires the future package to bind the exact Windows PowerShell executable, command, timeout, output cap, and sanitized parsing contract.

options.label: PowerShell 7 compatibility session
options.effect: Continue using implicit Windows PowerShell compatibility remoting and project properties after deserialization.
options.tradeoff: Smaller change but preserves the transport variable associated with the incomplete U3G projection.

options.label: CIM-only query
options.effect: Replace Get-MpComputerStatus with a CIM or WMI source selected in a later package.
options.tradeoff: Could avoid the Defender module proxy but no exact namespace, class, property, or support contract has been researched and sealed.

options.label: Defer status metadata
options.effect: Do not query Defender status in the next attempt.
options.tradeoff: Avoids the transport issue but leaves Defender binding unresolved.

options.label: Native version first, bounded latest-directory fallback
options.effect: Use native AMProductVersion when valid; otherwise inspect at most 64 direct regular non-reparse platform directories, parse version basenames, select one highest version, require one exact regular non-reparse MpCmdRun child, require directory/FileVersionInfo agreement, bind SHA-256, and require cache-only WinVerifyTrust.
options.tradeoff: Remains fail closed while following Microsoft's documented latest-platform location; a fallback candidate is never trusted by ordering alone.

options.label: AMProductVersion only
options.effect: Fail immediately whenever native Get-MpComputerStatus lacks a product version.
options.tradeoff: Simplest provenance chain but can repeat U3G without learning anything about an otherwise present platform binary.

options.label: Latest directory without trust gate
options.effect: Select the highest directory and accept its binary after a hash only.
options.tradeoff: Confuses recency with authenticity and weakens the accepted trust policy.

options.label: Program Files fallback first
options.effect: Prefer the operating-system fallback binary rather than the current ProgramData platform.
options.tradeoff: May bind an older fallback rather than the active updated platform.

options.label: Storage attempt then separate Defender attempt
options.effect: Prepare two independently digest-bound proposals: first a storage-only ACL/probe attempt, then a Defender-only metadata/hash/trust attempt after storage evidence is accepted. Each requires separate exact owner authorization.
options.tradeoff: Smallest failure domains and clearer evidence, at the cost of two explicit authorization cycles.

options.label: Combined storage and Defender attempt
options.effect: Retry both independent blockers under one authorization as U3G did.
options.tradeoff: Fewer owner decisions but one failure consumes authority for both paths and complicates diagnosis.

options.label: Defender attempt first
options.effect: Bind Defender before retrying storage.
options.tradeoff: Avoids F changes initially but does not advance the quarantine root needed for later acquisition.

options.label: Stop local binding work
options.effect: Do not prepare another laptop attempt.
options.tradeoff: Preserves current evidence but leaves storage and scanner-chain gates blocked.

options.label: Content-hashed reviewable runner proposal
options.effect: Require any future attempt package to include a human-reviewable, content-hashed transaction-runner source proposal, exact interpreter/runtime binding, generated-only contract tests, and default-deny action dispatch before separate implementation and execution authorization.
options.tradeoff: Improves reproducibility and auditability; selecting it authorizes only preparation of the proposal, not implementation or execution.

options.label: Ephemeral in-memory loader
options.effect: Continue constructing the one-shot transaction logic only in memory at execution time.
options.tradeoff: Minimizes persisted tooling but is harder to review, reproduce, test, and bind before authorization.

options.label: Manual command checklist
options.effect: Replace the transaction runner with operator-entered commands and screenshots or notes.
options.tradeoff: Simple but weakens deterministic timeouts, cleanup, sanitization, and exact action evidence.

options.label: Abstract action specification only
options.effect: Keep only prose and JSON action contracts with no proposed reviewable runner source.
options.tradeoff: Preserves planning boundaries but leaves another gap between owner-reviewed intent and actual execution mechanics.
